overviews.title: What is Dairy Technology?: Course Fees 2026, Subjects, Top Colleges, Admissions

blocks.value: Dairy Technology is a branch of engineering that focuses on the practical development and design of products involved in the dairy sector. The curriculum provides knowledge of techniques of Dairy Science i.e, the Science of processing and manufacturing milk and dairy products.

Some important Dairy technology subjects include Microbiology, Biochemistry, Dairy Engineering, Food Chemistry, Quality Control, etc . The course eligibility varies based on the course level and the college. You can formally pursue a course in Dairy Technology at various levels like UG, PG, Diploma and PhD.

The admission process can either be merit-based or entrance-based. Some popular Dairy Technology entrance exams are JEE Main , ICAR AIEEA, GUJCET, CUET, etc. DEI, Centurion University, Parul University, BHU Varanasi, etc are some colleges that offer Dairy Technology courses. Average fees for these colleges can lie between Rs. 50,000 and Rs. 3 Lakh.

There are many career options such as Scientist, Technologist, Nutritionist, Quality Controller, Microbiologist, etc., which can be pursued after a course in this field. The average dairy technology salary in India is Rs. 5 LPA to Rs. 10 LPA . Dairy Technology graduates work in areas like Manufacturing, Food Processing, Education, R&D, Healthcare, and so on.

faqs.question: What is Dairy Technology course all about?
faqs.answer: A part of Food Technology known as Dairy Technology. It deals with the preparation, storage, and quality assurance of dairy products. It is a science-based industry that uses Engineering, chemistry, and microbiological principles to guarantee the security and caliber of dairy items. Dairy technologists operate in a range of sectors, including the food service, packaging, and Dairy processing industries. Know more about - BTech Dairy Technology

faqs.question: What is the duration of Dairy Technology courses in India?
faqs.answer: The duration of Dairy Technology courses varies by course level . A diploma in Dairy Technology is 3 years long. B Tech Dairy Technology is 4 years long, while M Tech Dairy Technology is 2 years long in India. If you want to get into research, you can go for a PhD in Dairy Technology, which has a 3 to 6-year duration.

faqs.question: Is Dairy Technology better than Agriculture?
faqs.answer: Dairy Technology ensures the quality/safety of dairy products, while Agriculture more broadly supports the production of the diverse food and agricultural commodities we depend on. syllabus.title: Dairy Technology Syllabus 2026: Check Semester-wise Subjects & Syllabus

blocks.value: Are you looking forward to getting unlimited career opportunities in the private, government, or cooperative sectors? Yes? Dairy Technology is the ideal course you must opt for!

Mostly, the candidates who choose undergraduate or postgraduate in Dairy Technology can hope to have a lucrative career ahead. However, before we proceed and inform you about the Dairy Technology syllabus, subjects, examination pattern, entrance exams, and specialisations offered in this course, let's first get a detailed overview of Dairy Technology and the scope of a career in this magnificent stream.

Dairy Technology is a comprehensive study of food technology that primarily deals with dairy products' packaging, processing, distribution, storage, and transportation. These activities are performed by deploying the science of bacteriology, biochemistry, and nutrition.

The key areas and topics this course focuses on include animal husbandry, milk production, milk storage, cattle rearing, nutrition science, modern technology used in the dairy industry, management of dairy unit operations, etc.
One can opt for a degree or diploma in Dairy Technology suitable to their needs.
Syllabus- Important Facts for Dairy Technology

Additionally, students also undergo hands-on campus training in different college departments. The delivery method of the course includes practical sessions, classroom lectures, internships, and industrial visits.
List of Subjects in Dairy Technology

Getting expertise in Dairy Technology is not that easy. However, once you know all the core/elective subjects you need to study while you have opted for this course, it becomes empirical to crack the diploma or degree course you are going to pursue.
Typical Core Subjects for Dairy Technology

value: The module educates the students about the physical composition of distinctive species' milk. It also enlightens the candidates about milk's different properties, such as its density, velocity, etc.
The subject deals with an introduction to dairy units, dimensions, and properties of fluids (liquids and gases) in a state of rest or motion.

The eligible candidates are given a comprehensive introduction to fat-rich dairy products. They are mostly informed about the production of cream, a yellowish milk component rich in fat globules that naturally rises to the surface if milk is allowed to stand. Other fat-rich dairy products included in this subject are butter, ghee, fat spreads, butter powder, and butter oil.
The students are briefed on procedures, static strength, specifications, design factors, designing for fatigue conditions, and safety factors in this module.

The course entails discussing the introduction and history of packaging development, the most effective ways of packing milk, and the types of paper used, including grease-proof paper, kraft paper, glassine paper, vegetable parchment paper, line box boards, etc.

blocks.value: Typical Elective Subjects for Dairy Technology

value: The subject deals with the significance of refrigeration and air conditioning. Primarily, this course aims at educating them about the basic refrigeration cycles and crucial concepts required for the different types of milk.
The subject deals with basic maths concepts that are imperative for a dairy technologist professional to carry out regular activities.
The course entails discussing the complex microbiology of milk and the appropriate way to produce different types of milk in India and across the globe.
This section primarily aims at making students aware of the significance, status, and manufacturing of traditional milk products such as khoa/mawa, burfi, rabri, basundi, pantua, milk cake, etc.

Want to know the history and scope of condensed and dried milk in India? Students must pay heed to this subject, which will help them be educated about the status of dried milk in India and overseas. Moreover, students will also be informed about evaporated and condensed milk's legal standards.

blocks.value: Detailed Syllabus for Dairy Technology
Want to know the complete Dairy Technology syllabus? Let's check the table below mentioning all the eight semesters with one subject each:

value: The course's primary objective is to enlighten the candidates about the production of milk and the development of dairy products.
The 2nd semester educates the students about the physical chemistry of milk and how the relation between heat and other forms of energy are associated with milk processed products.
The candidates are given extensive knowledge on expanding the milk market. This module also helps students by providing a thorough understanding of milk processing and its products.

This section deals with starter cultures & fermented milk products. Moreover, the 4th semester briefs students on dairy process engineering, fundamentals of dairy extension, the chemistry of dairy products, and producing ice cream and frozen desserts.

The significance of quality assurance is the set of activities to ensure the manufactured product meets high-quality standards, is properly maintained, and packaged impeccably. The dairy industry's use of chemicals (acid, base, and salt) for testing, cleaning, sanitation, and as additives must be gauged and evaluated regularly.

The 6th semester involves studies related to material strength & dairy machine design, food & industrial microbiology, energy conservation & management, operations research, and dairy plant design & layout.
It is a workshop hosted by experts to train all participating candidates aspiring to become dairy technologists on how to identify, execute, and replicate energy-saving projects.

Students must go through the experimental learning module and get extensive knowledge about waste disposal, pollution reduction, making the best of food technology, and financial management & cost accounting in the last semester.

The concepts of cost-fixed and variable jobs, long-run costs, average and marginal costs, economies, and diseconomies of scale are introduced in this specialised course.

The specialised course educates students about the design and requirements of a sensory evaluation laboratory, classification of tastes and odours, fundamental rules for grading and scoring milk products, and desirable attributes and defects in cream or butter.

blocks.value: Entrance Exam for Dairy Technology

The entrance exam conducted for the course has various scopes that provide an opportunity to form a well-built educational foundation in the highly competitive market. These entrance exams for Dairy Technology are conducted to determine the student's aptitude, sharpness, and proficiency level.
Listed below is the entrance exam through which you can get admission to study Dairy Technology course in a recognised Indian university or college:
ICAR AIEEA Exam

The Indian Council of Agricultural Research conducts the All India Entrance Examination for Admission (AIEEA) for multiple undergraduate and postgraduate courses. It means AIEEA is not only opted for by students who want to enrol in Dairy Technology courses, but it is also chosen by the aspirants who want to pursue courses in the field like Forestry, Horticulture, Fisheries, etc.

It is an objective type computer-based test with a duration of 2 hours. The AIEEA is held for Dairy Technology undergraduate, postgraduate, and PhD degrees. However, the dates for the 2022 examination have not been announced yet.

questions.question_text: What is the total cost of studying the BTech Dairy Technology course at popular colleges?

answers.answer_text: The total cost of studying the B Tech Dairy Technology course in India includes the tuition fee, which is approximately INR 1 lakh to INR 4 lakh, depending on the college, and other extra charges like for hostel accommodation, college application, semester exam registration, lab work, and workshops. You should check the official websites of the colleges you're planning to apply to so that you have a clear picture in mind and can decide the college accordingly.

questions.question_text: How many full-time BTech Dairy Technology colleges are there in India?

answers.answer_text: There are around 45 full-time B Tech Dairy Technology colleges in India that you can check out for pursuing the course . When it comes to the colleges under government jurisdiction, BHU, National Dairy Research Institute, Anand Agricultural University, Dairy Science College (Bangalore), and College of Food and Dairy Technology stand out as a few popular options. Coming to the private colleges, Centurion University of Technology and Management (Orissa), Parul University (Vadodara), NIMS Institute of Engineering and Technology (Jaipur), SHUATS Allahabad, and A. D. Patel Institute of Technology stand as popular student choices.
